course: Synopsys DFT Compiler 1, 2010.03 official labs ported to V-2023.12-SP3
source_policy: The official tree and the existing runtime copy are read-only evidence. A result is not passed until every listed acceptance check succeeds and an engineer approves it.

labs.topic: RTL test protocol and baseline DFT DRC
labs.objective: Learn the order RTL read, DFT signal declaration, create_test_protocol, then dft_drc.
workflow: Read RTL with the finite-state-machine compatibility setting before elaboration.
Declare ScanClock, Reset, ScanEnable, and Constant signals.
Create the protocol, run DRC, then inspect scan-state evidence.
porting_notes: Use set_app_var hdlin_always_fsm_complete false before reading the legacy VHDL.
A non-scan shift-register cell is an observation, not automatically a failure.

labs.objective: Show how test_setup reduces controllability-related DRC findings without hiding model or topology defects.
workflow: Read and link mapped ORCA.
Capture initial DRC evidence.
Read the test_setup section, rebuild the protocol, and compare the two DRC reports.
porting_notes: Add . to search_path and use read_file -format ddc mapped/ORCA.ddc instead of read_ddc.
Declare pclk, sdr_clk, and sys_clk in separate set_dft_signal commands.

labs.topic: TEST_MODE, scan endpoints, and pre/post insertion DRC
labs.objective: Use TEST_MODE to make the RTL testable, then verify an explicitly connected scan chain.
workflow: Measure RTL DRC before TEST_MODE.
Add the Constant TEST_MODE definition and rebuild the protocol.
Select VHDL bus bit 0 through port collections, preview, insert, then run post-insertion DRC.
porting_notes: Do not pass unescaped Instrn[0] or Xecutng_Instrn[0] text to Tcl; select bit 0 through get_ports and index_collection.
Do not call an insertion complete just because preview_dft ran; inspect post-DFT DRC and report_scan_path.

labs.topic: Design Vision teaching flow and report interpretation
labs.objective: Distinguish unconnected-input messages from sequential DFT-rule violations.
workflow: Run the teaching script in command mode.
Review hierarchy and DRC reports.
Classify TEST-332 input connectivity messages separately from scan DRC.
porting_notes: Use current source paths and full option names such as existing_dft and active_state.
Do not claim a clean design merely because the script exits without Error:.

labs.objective: Repair uncontrollable clock, reset, and set paths with an explicit AutoFix configuration.
workflow: Read the gate design and existing protocol.
Define AutoFix data/control signals.
Remove and rebuild the protocol before preview_dft.
Insert scan and check the final DRC and coverage.
porting_notes: After specification-view edits, use remove_test_protocol followed by create_test_protocol before preview_dft.

labs.topic: Top-down six-chain insertion and lock-up latches
labs.objective: Verify all six physical endpoints and distinguish a valid scan structure from residual model/topology findings.
workflow: Read and link ORCA.
Select the pad and sd_A bus bits from port collections.
Preview, insert, inspect each named chain, then review coverage and residual DRC by class.
porting_notes: Tcl evaluates brackets in pad[i] and sd_A[i]; supply port collections to set_dft_signal and set_scan_path.
A nonzero aggregate DRC total needs categorization; it is not proof that the six scan chains failed.

labs.topic: Test handoff, SCANDEF, and TestMAX ATPG
labs.objective: Export a self-consistent scan netlist, SPF, SCANDEF, and DDC, then contrast DFTC estimation with real ATPG.
workflow: Read initialization protocol and insert six scan chains.
Write Verilog, SPF, and SCANDEF before DDC.
Check SCANDEF, syntax-check the Verilog, then run TestMAX including fast sequential ATPG.
porting_notes: Use report_dft_signal -view existing_dft, write -format verilog -hierarchy, write_test_protocol, and write_scan_def.
DFTC coverage estimation and TestMAX pattern coverage measure different stages; do not equate them.

labs.topic: Hierarchical scan, ILM, and bottom-up/top-down comparison
labs.objective: Establish separate acceptance criteria for block-level scan, ILM scan, and top-level integration before calling the hierarchical flow complete.
workflow: Audit the latest block and ILM reports first.
Separate intended multi-clock/topology warnings from runtime crashes.
Require a clean scripted completion record for each selected hierarchical flow.
porting_notes: The runtime tree contains recent stack-trace artifacts, so prior outputs are evidence, not a completion certificate.
Never collapse per-block DRC and coverage into a single top-level pass/fail number.

labs.objective: Separate successful internal scan insertion from compression-flow compatibility and coverage acceptance.
workflow: Audit pre-DFT, internal scan, and scan-compression DRC separately.
Treat unsupported command errors as blockers even when later checks produce files.
Verify compression handoff and TestMAX behavior before approval.
porting_notes: The current runtime record contains CMD-005 for _snps_array_peek and an unsupported report option. These require a version-aware script repair, not suppression.
FAILED 0 for the available scan-chain check is encouraging evidence but does not clear the earlier execution errors.
